features.description: Close-time enforcement + disposition. Extend completion_auditor to emit consumer_outcome_unproven and apply a DETERMINISTIC enforcement posture. POSTURE (rewritten per D047 to match the acceptance): a pure posture function returns block|advisory|noop gated on has_consumer_journey (NEVER on goal_type or product_metadata alone). At plan close: ANY active consumer-journey-bearing plan (product-class OR substrate) BLOCKS an unproven consumer outcome unless each declared consumer outcome is satisfied (via 2a-core/2a-F004 checkers), structurally deferred via a non_goal {journey,consumer}, or operator-dispositioned via a structured record (D030/D043); a journey-bearing plan does NOT block when every outcome is satisfied, deferred, dispositioned, OR consumer_outcome_pending (pending is a per-journey advisory state, never a block, D049); an active PRODUCT-CLASS plan that declares NO consumer journey emits no_consumer_journey_declared (advisory, never blocks, D031); a SUBSTRATE plan active solely via opt_in with NO consumer journey is advisory/warn (D030); a plan with none of the activation triggers is a gate no-op. CONSUMER CARDINALITY (D034/D035): consumer=human/=agent -> the named family's verdict decides; consumer=both -> the ENFORCED agent family missing-or-unsatisfied -> consumer_outcome_unproven (block), a TYPED-but-unsatisfied human family -> unproven (block), but a NOT_YET_TYPED human family -> consumer_outcome_pending (advisory, never blocks, D035 — not a binary 'both families proven' rule). Typed-skip and seeded evidence never count as consumer-surface captures; the >=1-real requirement is about JOURNEY EXECUTION provenance, not data-source availability (a required_data_source honestly degraded within a real execution still satisfies, D015). The actual close BLOCK is a DETERMINISTIC pre-flip gate in completion_gate.close_plan (consumer_outcome_gate), NOT the LLM F0 cluster triage (whose only blocking triage is child_plan): completion_auditor's consumer_outcome_unproven finding is the advisory/observability surface, while the deterministic gate independently blocks the active->completed flip (D021). The gate ACTIVATES when ANY of (D022): (a) plan.md frontmatter experience_readiness_opt_in: true; (b) the objective_contract declares any user_journey with a consumer set; OR (c) goal_type is product-class {parity, new_feature, migration, incident} OR product_metadata (parsed from frontmatter delivery_class, fail-closed on typo, D041/D044) marks product/migration/readiness/ux/consumer-facing delivery. opt_in is NOT the only activation path — a product claim cannot dodge the gate by omitting the frontmatter field.
features.acceptance: experience_readiness_active(goal_type, opted_in, has_consumer_journey, product_metadata) is PURE and returns True iff opted_in OR has_consumer_journey OR goal_type in {parity,new_feature,migration,incident} OR product_metadata is product-class (D022). product_metadata is parsed from plan.md frontmatter delivery_class (closed enum product|migration|readiness|ux|consumer_facing|substrate|mechanical|infra|refactor) by a pure parse_product_metadata: {product,migration,readiness,ux,consumer_facing} -> product-class; {substrate,mechanical,infra,refactor} -> substrate; an UNRECOGNIZED NON-EMPTY value FAILS CLOSED to product-class so a typo never weakens activation (D041/D044); but an ABSENT delivery_class (key not present) yields NO product_metadata signal — it does NOT activate via trigger (c), so a plan with no opt_in, no consumer journey, and a non-product goal_type remains a gate NO-OP (D048 — absent != invalid). opted_in is read from frontmatter experience_readiness_opt_in (D022). enforcement_posture(goal_type, opted_in, has_consumer_journey, product_metadata, outcome_state) returns exactly one of {block, advisory, noop}, decided SOLELY by these rules (the substrate/product label is never a shortcut): (noop) iff NOT experience_readiness_active(...); (block) iff active AND has_consumer_journey AND the outcome is unsatisfied-and-undeferred-and-undispositioned — this holds for ANY consumer-journey-bearing plan INCLUDING substrate (D030/D043); (advisory) is the PLAN-LEVEL posture in exactly the two active-but-no-consumer-journey cases: (a) an active PRODUCT-CLASS plan that declares NO consumer journey -> emit no_consumer_journey_declared (D031); (b) a SUBSTRATE plan active solely via opt_in with NO consumer journey -> opt-in-visibility warn (D030). PLAN-vs-OUTCOME (D049): plan-level block requires >=1 declared consumer outcome that is UNPROVEN-and-undeferred-and-undispositioned; a journey-bearing plan whose every outcome is satisfied, structurally deferred, dispositioned, OR consumer_outcome_pending does NOT block (close proceeds) — consumer_outcome_pending is a PER-JOURNEY advisory outcome state, never itself a block, distinct from the plan-level (a)/(b) advisory posture. CRITICAL INVARIANT: posture is NEVER block on goal_type or product_metadata ALONE — a product-class plan with NO consumer journey is ADVISORY (no_consumer_journey_declared), not block; block requires has_consumer_journey. Per declared consumer journey, the completion_auditor computes the consumer outcome via the MERGED checkers (D032 prereq — 2a-core 2026-06-15-001 @1b90198 + 2a-F004 2026-06-15-002 @f4ef2b9 are merged; the gate IMPORTS them and never redefines schema): per-family capture from experience_readiness_typing.check_journey(consumer, requirements, refs) -> (results, JourneyVerdict in {satisfied, agent_satisfied_human_pending, unsatisfied}); honesty / real-vs-degraded from experience_readiness_honesty.check_degraded_honesty(required_sources, allowed_degraded_modes, refs) -> HonestyResult {verdict in {honest, degraded_dishonest, human_not_yet_typed_pending}, satisfied: bool}, with check_objectives(...) for objective-keyed grouping (D033). 'real journey-EXECUTION' IS HonestyResult.satisfied over 2a-F004 EXECUTION_CLASSES (2a-F004 D005/D011) — there is no separate F005. The per-journey outcome is TRI-STATE (D034/D035): (unsatisfied OR degraded_dishonest) -> consumer_outcome_unproven (BLOCKS unless structurally deferred or dispositioned); (satisfied AND honest) -> pass; (agent_satisfied_human_pending OR human_not_yet_typed_pending) -> consumer_outcome_pending, a STRUCTURED advisory record that is NEITHER a pass NOR a block (honors 2a-core D060 'human producer typing later'; a future human-typing increment MAY promote it to block). CONSUMER CARDINALITY: consumer=human or =agent -> the named family's verdict decides; consumer=both -> BOTH families, where the ENFORCED AGENT family missing-or-unsatisfied -> unproven (block), a TYPED-but-unsatisfied HUMAN family -> unproven (block), and a NOT_YET_TYPED human family -> pending (advisory, D035, no explicit non_goal required). NON-SATISFYING EVIDENCE: substrate-only, seeded-only, or typed-skip-only NEVER satisfy. Satisfaction requires >=1 real (non-seeded) end-to-end journey-EXECUTION ref (HonestyResult.satisfied over EXECUTION_CLASSES) per (objective=UserJourney.name, declared consumer); the EXECUTION ref being available+real refers to the journey RUNNING on the real surface, NOT to every dependency — a required_data_source honestly degraded (availability=unavailable, 2a-F004) WITHIN that real execution STILL satisfies (D050: degraded dependency != failed execution) — only an entirely seeded / substrate-only / typed-skip-only journey fails (D015). DEFERRAL/DISPOSITION are STRUCTURED only (prose never satisfies, D016): deferral = an objective_contract non_goal entry naming {journey, consumer}; disposition = a consumer_outcome_dispositions[] record {journey, consumer, reason, dispositioned_by, at}. Either one allows close for that {journey, consumer}. CLOSE PATH: consumer_outcome_gate(contract, evidence, goal_type, opted_in, dispositions, product_metadata) (D036) is a DETERMINISTIC pre-flip gate that completion_gate.close_plan invokes BEFORE the active->completed flip and INDEPENDENTLY of the codex F0 cluster triage (D021); it blocks the flip iff posture==block for some required consumer outcome that is unproven-undeferred-undispositioned. TAXONOMY (gap_class entries, all with the parallel output shape {finding_id, gap_class, severity, journey, consumer, note}): consumer_outcome_unproven (blocking severity); consumer_outcome_pending (advisory rank below unproven, never blocks, D034/D044); no_consumer_journey_declared (advisory, never blocks, D039). TESTS (deterministic): (1) product-class human journey, API-only evidence -> unproven + close BLOCKED; (2) + a real screenshot capture -> pass, not blocked; (3) seeded-only screenshot on a real journey -> unproven + blocked; (4) a structured disposition recorded -> close allowed; (5) substrate, NO journeys, not opted-in -> noop (not blocked); (6) typed-skip-only -> unproven; (7) consumer=both with only a human capture -> unproven (AGENT family unproven) + blocked; (8) real journey whose required_data_source is honestly degraded -> satisfied, not blocked; (9) the gate blocks the active->completed flip even when the codex envelope is agree/empty (gate-driven, not triage-driven); (10) substrate opted_in + an unproven consumer journey -> blocks; (11) NO-DODGE: product-class + unproven journey + NO opt_in -> activates + blocks; (12) ANY consumer-journey-bearing plan (incl substrate) blocks an unproven outcome regardless of opt_in; (13) NO-JOURNEY: an active product-class plan that declares NO consumer journey -> no_consumer_journey_declared (advisory), close NOT blocked (D031); (14) consumer=both, agent proven + human not_yet_typed -> consumer_outcome_pending, NOT blocked (deferred, not pass); (15) degraded_dishonest verdict -> block; (16) the pending outcome is recorded as a structured record, not silently dropped; (17) structured non_goal deferral {journey,consumer} -> close allowed; (18) prose-only deferral -> still BLOCKS; (19) substrate opted_in + NO journeys -> advisory; (20) no_consumer_journey_declared emitted with the advisory shape and never blocks; (21) product-class (delivery_class=product) human journey with substrate-only evidence -> unproven + blocks; (22) parse_product_metadata maps each enum value to product-class/substrate deterministically, with absent -> product-class (fail-closed); (23) a typo delivery_class ('prodct') -> product-class activation + blocks; (24) consumer_outcome_pending taxonomy/output shape; (25) IMPLEMENTATION OBLIGATION — the COMPLETE posture matrix enumerated over (opt_in x has_consumer_journey x product-class goal_type x product_metadata product-class) asserting block/advisory/noop per cell consistent with the posture rules above (D045); (26) IMPLEMENTATION OBLIGATION — objective-keyed grouping: one real execution does NOT satisfy multiple journeys sharing a data_source (mirrors 2a-F004 multi-objective isolation, D045). PREREQUISITE (D032): SATISFIED — 2a-core (1b90198) + 2a-F004 (f4ef2b9) merged to main; gate imports the merged checkers/enums, no schema redefinition. NOTE (D047): this acceptance was REWRITTEN FROM SCRATCH to state each rule exactly once after accreted round-by-round prose drifted into self-contradiction; the posture-block rule is now gated on has_consumer_journey (NOT goal_type), and the prior fixture_only close-bypass (old D046) is REMOVED — fixture_only grants no exemption (the contract lists no such bypass); a fixture_only journey is simply not a real consumer-outcome claim and is out of this gate's scope.
